<thought>I need to find a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the substitution of an aliphatic hydroxyl group with a halogen (Cl, Br, I). This template should break a C–O bond and form a C–X bond, where X is a halogen. I will search the template catalog for templates that break the functional group “aliphatic hydroxyl” and form a halogen-containing functional group (e.g., “alkyl halide”). The search does not require a specific target molecule, so I can use a simple placeholder SMILES like “CCO” (ethanol) to represent a molecule with an aliphatic OH.</analysis<|message|>{
    "tool_name": "search_template_catalog_by_criteria",
    "arguments": {
        "molecule_smiles": "CCO",
        "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyl"],
        "functional_groups_formed": ["alkyl halide"]
    }
}
